verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Man of sorrows
Cast down with grief
Despised afflicted
For all to see

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
The lamb of God was slain
Now I am free
I give my life to love
As You loved me

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
How deep the Father's love for us
How vast that crimson sea
I give my life, Lord Jesus
To love as You first loved me

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
I'm forgiven I am redeemed
From death's dominion
You've rescued me
The love of God is a flood it covers me
I give my life to love
As You loved me

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Oh love of God
How rich, how pure
How measureless and strong
It shall forevermore endure
The saints and angels song
